local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=-1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 print('ScalesUiFrame')
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching real Wellspring Scales')
 print('ScalesCarry count='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x105f3)))
 print(string.format('ScalesApproach level aim x=0 y=%d',math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*512+.5)))
 if math.abs(camera.getPitch())<.1 then print('ScalesApproach pitch level') end
 local target=nil
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.items) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x105f3) then target=obj;break end end
 if not target then print('ScalesApproach target absent');return end
 print('ScalesApproach target item=true'..' position='..tostring(target.position)..' player='..tostring(self.position))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local dv=target.position-self.position
 local yaw=math.atan2(view.y*dv.x-view.x*dv.y,view.x*dv.x+view.y*dv.y)
 print(string.format('ScalesApproach walk aim x=%d y=0',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5)))))
 if math.sqrt(dv.x*dv.x+dv.y*dv.y)<90 then print('ScalesApproach close') end
 local box=target:getBoundingBox();local aim=nil
 for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,z in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
 local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,z*box.halfSize.z);local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,point,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==target then aim=hit.hitPos;break end
 end;if aim then break end end;if aim then break end end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim or box.center);local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('ScalesApproach item aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5)))))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if ray.hitObject==target and ray.hitPos and (ray.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('ScalesApproach focused in native range') end
end}}}}
